name: Configuration & Change Management (OpenUP Capability Pattern)
description: EPF/OpenUP's Configuration and Change Management capability pattern, modelled as a Pack: change-control work products and the tasks for requesting, dispositioning, and baselining changes to engineering assets.

capabilities.name: Configuration & Change Management
capabilities.description: Controls change and maintains the integrity of engineering assets under baseline.

checklists.name: Configuration & Change Management (OpenUP Capability Pattern) Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for change requests, impact analysis, and asset baselining.

items.statement: A proposed change is recorded with its rationale and impact.
Version control and baselining are established for the project's assets.
Change requests undergo formal impact assessment covering scope, schedule, and cost.
Approved changes are linked to corresponding backlog tasks and verification tests.

reviewGates.name: Configuration Management Review
reviewGates.statement: The Configuration Management Plan and Change Request procedures have been reviewed and accepted.
reviewGates.prompt: Are configuration management rules and change control procedures established and operational?
checklistIds: Configuration & Change Management (OpenUP Capability Pattern) Checklist

obligationDefinitions.title: An aging, undispositioned Change Request must be escalated, not left indefinitely open
obligationDefinitions.description: OpenUP's change-control process requires every Change Request to reach a disposition; a request sitting undispositioned past its expected cycle time silently blocks the work items depending on it and must be escalated rather than left in the backlog.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: No Change Request remains undispositioned past its declared aging threshold without escalation.

requiredEvidence.title: Change Request aging report
requiredEvidence.description: Report of Change Requests exceeding the aging threshold and their escalation status.
